01 / GRANT-AWARDED PROJECT

AI-enabled cyber risks and digital resilience workshops

Awarded the Queensland Government’s Empowering Queensland Women Grant Program.

A set of workshops were designed to help participants understand and navigate emerging AI-enabled cyber risks, including deepfake technology, AI-generated scams, phishing attacks, voice cloning, online privacy threats, and AI bias. Through interactive activities and real-world scenarios, students will develop practical digital safety skills, critical thinking capabilities, and awareness of future STEM and cybersecurity opportunities.

The workshops cover four key areas

AI-Enabled Cyber Threats

Recognise AI-generated phishing, deepfakes and online threats.

Personal Digital Resilience

Improve online safety and account protection.

Understanding AI Bias and Misuse

Understand AI manipulation and fairness issues.

Critical Thinking and Safe AI Use

Develop critical thinking and explore career opportunities.
